label: Steel cabinet
solvedMessage: Open. Whatever Arthur kept here, you have it now.

actions.text: Mercer copies of Society minutes, bound by year, 1871 to 1936. Every volume has the same clean slit down the gutter where pages were taken out.

label: Iron grille
lockedMessage: An iron grille across the old passage west. The lock plate is stamped with a seal: a circle, a line, eight points.
unlockMessage: Ruth's key turns as if it had never been anywhere else.
